values.note: 107 campsites on the booking site (60 Modern Electric, 22 Full-Hookup, 23 Modern Non-Electric, 2 walk-to tent-only) besides 16 rustic cabins. Listed max vehicle length is 30 ft at most sites, 20-25 ft at about 25, 40 ft at two (039 Full-Hookup, 108 Modern Electric). Every campsite is listed back-in.

sites.source: https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/parker-dam-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880117 (site list and each site's details page: Max Vehicle Length, driveway entry), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Campsites can be booked up to 11 months ahead and for the same day (ReserveAmerica booking window). Up to 14 days in the summer season and 21 off-season, then 48 hours out of the park between stays.

summary: Confirmed inherited reservable/ReserveAmerica/11-month window/14-night max for this park; season (mid-April to mid-December) already manual. Added 50-amp electric with water+sewer at 22 full-hookup sites, 107 campsites to 40 ft (mostly 30 ft, all back-in), showers, flush toilets, dump, coin laundry, seasonal camp store. Not stated for this park: the Saturday 2-night summer minimum (left inherited), the noon cutoff, fcfs. Fees left as recorded.
